goal: flywheel triage runs as a label-polling daemon by default and with --once executes exactly one triage pass and exits 0, while a malformed [triage] policy exits 2 before any GitHub write and an idle pass writes nothing and continues the loop.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-orchestrator packages/flywheel

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_triage_run.py -- NEW: CLI shell and daemon loop for the triage engine
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- bind the [triage] table (intake_label, ready_label, needs_detail_label, interval_seconds, max_per_pass)
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_autopilot_run.py -- mirror the daemon shell: run_daemon_loop, make_logger, flag precedence, exit codes, signal handling
constraints: [triage] defaults: intake_label 'flywheel', ready_label 'flywheel:ready', needs_detail_label 'flywheel:needs-detail', interval_seconds 300.0; a malformed value raises PolicyError and the verb exits 2 before constructing the engine or issuing any GitHub call
Wire max_per_pass from policy into the engine's cap argument
Daemon semantics mirror autopilot: never terminates on an idle cycle, finishes the current pass on SIGTERM/SIGINT, --once runs one pass and exits 0
Update the operator docs that test_docs_parity.py checks so the new verb passes the existing parity gate
Commit the change with a Conventional Commit message before reporting done
non_goals: No console supervisor integration (/triage start) -- explicitly out of spec scope
Do not modify the triage engine's pass logic or the receipt schema
Do not modify existing tests; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Idle pass (no intake, no drifted ready issues): zero GitHub writes and the loop schedules the next cycle
Policy error must exit 2 with zero captured gh calls -- the write-free guarantee is the assertion, not just the exit code
